title: Supertrux

exclude: CPU port, work variables, stack, bootloader and pointer arrays built by startup. The game tape image enters at $080D.
Handoff holds the Novaload screen program and boot screen cells. The game builds shape lookup arrays here and assigns glyph indices at runtime.
Title screen matrix: $3BEF initializes its 1000 cells and $1049 uploads the title sprite pointers when this screen is selected. The VIC ignores the gap between the cells and pointer slots.
Race display matrices and sprite pointer slots. Startup clears or derives the cells and pointers before play and uses the pages as map conversion scratch.
Startup copies the title staging image to $6900–$7DFF before the first watchpoint read from this range in the transform at $1401. The freed region is rewritten as bitmap and race-character output.
extra: Elite tape blocks 3–8 at the point control enters the game. Keep the full loaded extent in the ledger while classifying its data.
include: Elite tape block 3 relocated here by the loader. Read as title map by $137D with I/O banked out.

io: Startup banks out I/O while it reads the loaded map and rearranges the pixel and attribute arrays.
Title renderer copies map attributes from RAM beneath the chips.
